plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Loma Linda University 2026-2027 Catalog (effective Summer Quarter 2026) program page 'Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) - Certificate' (School of Allied Health Professions, Department of Radiation Technology, Special Imaging). The catalog publishes the two-quarter curriculum: Autumn: 8, Winter: 8 = 16 = catalog Total Units 16. RTSI 970 (Special Imaging (CT/MRI) Affiliation) is listed at 2-3 units in both quarters; the catalog's Total Units 16 corresponds exactly to the 3-unit-per-quarter composition (fixed courses 10 + affiliation 3+3 = 16), and the catalog footnote describes registering for 3 units over two quarters to fulfill the 6-unit affiliation requirement - consistent with the 3-unit composition - so it is encoded at 3 units with the 2-unit alternative documented. RTSI 970 repeats in both quarters exactly as published; allow_repeated_courses is set. The Winter Quarter religion row is a catalog placeholder ('REL__ 4____ Upper or Lower Division Religion elective'); it is encoded as a REL-ELECT choice slot whose options are the religion courses the catalog lists for this program: RELT 423 Loma Linda Perspectives, RELT 436 Adventist Heritage and Health, RELE 457 Christian Ethics and Health Care, RELT 415 Christian Theology and Popular Culture. The program begins in autumn and spring quarters. Per-course prerequisites are not published; the published quarter order is the official sequence, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
